svg.title: Rotational invariance determines the required angular moments without a sphere normalization convention. Equal diagonal moments and P a k2 a = r2 give R Aμ k2 a/r6 = Jμ/4. For a ̸= b, rotate a unit vector to (ea + eb)/ √ 2 and to (ea −eb)/ √ 2. Add their fourth-power identities; the odd terms cancel and give R k4 a/r8 = 3 R k2 ak2 b/r8. Summing the mixed moments over b then gives
